why: The ONLY surviving record of weeks 1-2 under the new IDP settings. Written by the 2026-09-24T07:35Z sync, which ran after the scoring change and before the commissioner reverted it. weekly_actuals.json is rewritten every sync, so the next one destroys this. first_recorded_scores.jsonl holds the OLD scale for the same weeks (B19, frozen on first write); together they bracket the change at team level, which is what any re-derivation across the boundary needs. Sleeper keeps no scoring history, so neither side is recoverable afterwards.
